{{Top|leg}}
'''Sled foxes''' were small predators of [[Berea]] who lived in snow-covered mountains. Their hind limbs resembled skis.
It used its fangs to catch several small herbivores, including the flightless [[Berea]]n [[snow stork]] and a [[Rabbit/Legends|lagomorph]] species called [[chickatili]]s by local settlers because of their peculiar mating calls.
